meta.title: CIMIC Analytical Layers
meta.note: Sample/illustrative analytical content for UI prototype. Replace with analyst-produced, sourced reporting.

layers.name: Governance & Administration
layers.bluf: Local administrative capacity is uneven; service continuity holds in urban centres but lapses in contested peripheries.
findings: De facto authorities established in most governorates; coordination interfaces still maturing.
Civil registry and documentation gaps complicate returns and aid eligibility.
layers.purpose: Maps who governs and whether essential public functions keep running.

layers.name: Population & Displacement
layers.bluf: Net displacement is declining as large-scale returns continue, but secondary displacement persists near friction lines.
findings: Returns concentrated in a few governorates; absorption capacity strained.
Camp populations decreasing yet residual caseload remains highly vulnerable.
layers.purpose: Tracks where people are moving, returning, and concentrating.

layers.name: Infrastructure & Essential Services
layers.bluf: Essential services operate well below capacity; water and energy shortfalls are the binding constraints on recovery.
findings: Power availability intermittent; reliance on costly private generation.
Water systems degraded; drought compounds scarcity in agricultural zones.
layers.purpose: Monitors the condition and availability of essential services.

layers.name: Economy & Livelihoods
layers.bluf: Liquidity shortages and price volatility suppress purchasing power; livelihoods remain fragile.
findings: Minimum Expenditure Basket cost rising faster than wages.
Cash access constrained; informal economy dominant.
layers.purpose: Assesses market function, prices, and household purchasing power.

layers.name: Humanitarian Actors & Coordination
layers.bluf: Coordination architecture is consolidating under a unified structure; funding shortfalls drive hard prioritization.
findings: Cluster coverage strong in accessible areas, thin in periphery.
Appeal underfunded; activities reprioritized to highest-severity needs.
layers.purpose: Maps humanitarian presence, access, and funding against need.

layers.name: Public Health
layers.bluf: Health system capacity is critically reduced; outbreak and malnutrition risks are elevated.
findings: Significant share of facilities non- or partially functional; workforce depleted.
Water-related disease risk rising alongside drought and WASH gaps.
layers.purpose: Monitors health-system capacity, disease risk, and nutrition.

layers.name: Social & Cultural Dynamics
layers.bluf: Inter-community tensions are localized but sensitive; the information environment is contested.
findings: Returns and resource competition create friction in some communities.
Rumour and misinformation affect aid uptake and perceptions.
layers.purpose: Reads community cohesion, the information environment, and protection.

layers.name: Hazard & Environment
layers.bluf: Climate stress and explosive-ordnance contamination are persistent, cross-cutting drivers of need.
findings: Severe drought reduces agricultural output and water access.
Explosive ordnance causes recurring civilian casualties and blocks land use.
layers.purpose: Tracks climate, explosive-ordnance, and disaster risk as cross-cutting drivers.
